# Sartre: Romantic Rationalist

*[Iris Murdoch](../philosophers/iris-murdoch.md) · 1953*

The first book on [Sartre](../philosophers/sartre.md) in English. [Murdoch](../philosophers/iris-murdoch.md) reads his novels as much as his philosophy, with critical sympathy: she already charges Sartrean freedom with leaving the self alone in a world emptied of value.
